$comment: VERIFIED MEMBERS — businesses whose owner has paid AND had ownership verified, and whose preview page therefore renders Live. Derived from mva's previews/claims-snapshot.json, which is a census of activate's D1. Written by scripts/sync-previews-manifest.mjs; never by hand.
$why_not_claimed_json: mva's previews/claimed.json is hand-written and its build-time reconciliation against D1 is scoped to the ONE tranche being built, so it proves nothing about a self-serve DNS claim in another category. The snapshot is whole-corpus. A cross-tranche surface needs the whole-corpus source.
$absent_is_not_empty: A missing or unreadable file throws rather than resolving to zero members — dropping a paid member silently is the failure this file exists to prevent.
